heroTitle: Locally Owned Lawn Care in Western MA
heroSubtitle: Trimming Edge is a family-operated lawn care company based in Montgomery, MA - built on hard work, local pride, and a perfect 5-star reputation.
storyText: Trimming Edge started with a simple belief: that lawn care should be personal, professional, and consistent. David and Amanda founded the company in Montgomery, MA with a single truck, a few tools, and a commitment to treating every property like their own.

Word spread quickly. Neighbors told neighbors. Today, Trimming Edge serves homeowners and businesses across Westfield, Huntington, Russell, Montgomery, and surrounding areas - all while maintaining the same hands-on approach that made us successful from day one.

As a locally owned business, we take extra pride in proving that quality, attention to detail, and reliability are what define great lawn care - and we have built a perfect 5-star reputation to prove it.
storyImageAlt: Trimming Edge owners and lawn care team
valuesSubtitle: Every decision we make - from how we schedule visits to how we communicate - comes back to these core values.
valuesQuote: "We treat every property as if it were our own."

values.title: Quality First
values.description: We never rush. Every mow, every edge, every cleanup is done with precision and care. Your property deserves our best work - every single visit.

values.title: Reliability You Can Count On
values.description: We show up when we say we will. Consistency is at the heart of great lawn care, and our customers know they can count on us week after week.

values.title: Customer First, Always
values.description: From your first call to the finished job, we treat you like a neighbor - because you are one. Your satisfaction is not just a goal, it's our guarantee.

values.title: Community Pride
values.description: We're based in Montgomery, MA and care deeply about the communities we serve. Beautiful properties make better neighborhoods - and that matters to us.

differentiatorsSubtitle: There are a lot of lawn care companies in Western Massachusetts. Here's why homeowners and businesses across Westfield, Huntington, Russell, and Montgomery keep coming back to us - and why they refer their neighbors.
differentiatorsImageAlt: Trimming Edge professional equipment and service

differentiators.title: You Work Directly With the Owners
differentiators.description: No call centers, no middlemen. When you call Trimming Edge, David or Amanda picks up. That direct relationship means faster answers, better service, and real accountability.

differentiators.title: We Live In the Community We Serve
differentiators.description: We're based right here in Montgomery, MA. When we drive through Westfield or Huntington, we see the lawns we care for. That local pride shows in every job we do.

differentiators.title: Perfect 5-Star Record - Every Review
differentiators.description: Not almost-perfect. Perfect. Every Google review we've ever received is a 5-star review. That's not luck - it's the result of genuinely caring about each customer's property.

differentiators.title: Consistent Scheduling, Every Time
differentiators.description: We show up on the day we say we will. Consistent scheduling builds trust, and trust is what keeps our customers coming back season after season.

differentiators.title: Licensed, Insured & 100% Accountable
differentiators.description: Fully licensed and insured in Massachusetts. We protect your property, your investment, and your peace of mind on every single visit.

differentiators.title: Clear Communication, No Surprises
differentiators.description: We give you honest estimates, explain what's included, and communicate proactively. No hidden fees, no surprises - just straight-forward, professional service.

gallerySubtitle: Every property we service gets the same treatment - precision, care, and a clean finish that makes your home stand out in the neighborhood.

galleryBannerText: We treat your lawn like it's our own.
faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about working with Trimming Edge.

faq.question: How long has Trimming Edge been in business?
faq.answer: We have been serving the Western Massachusetts community for several years, building a loyal customer base and a perfect 5.0 Google rating with all five-star reviews. Our reputation is built entirely on word-of-mouth from happy neighbors.

faq.question: What makes Trimming Edge different from other lawn care companies?
faq.answer: We are locally owned and operated - not a franchise. When you hire us, you work directly with David and Amanda, not a call center. We show up on time, communicate proactively, and treat your property like it's our own. That personal accountability is what has earned us a perfect 5-star rating.

faq.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faq.answer: Yes! We provide completely free, no-obligation estimates for all lawn care and landscaping services. Call (413) 551-9653 or fill out our online form and we will get back to you promptly.

faq.question: Are you licensed and insured?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Trimming Edge is fully licensed, bonded, and insured in Massachusetts to protect both our team and your property.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We proudly serve Westfield, Huntington, Russell, Montgomery, Agawam, and Southwick in Western Massachusetts.

historyHeroTitle: The History of Wolf Radio & Wolf Enterprise
historyHeroSubtitle: From radio waves to lawn care - the DnA story of David & Amanda.
historyIntroText: We have been through some changes. Starting in Radio back in 1996 as Wolf Radio, then becoming Wolf Enterprise when David and Amanda started the DnA Show, and eventually launching Trimming Edge Lawn Care.
historyParagraphs: We have been through some changes. Starting in Radio back in 1996 as Wolf Radio (Wolf Radio LLC). We also became Wolf Enterprise when my wife Amanda and I started the radio show the DnA Show.

(DnA stands for David & Amanda) This show focused on technology and computer repair. I also make, on-site house calls for repairing computers. Amanda also started her Pet Sitting business. However with the ever changing technology world, where people no longer fix computers like they use to, it is time we go in a new direction. With that the launch of: Trimming Edge Lawn Care.
Wolf Radio has returned. We are still broadcasting at AM Stereo 1690 and 107.5 FM. The Stream has Returned to as well as under the About tab on this site.
Trimming Edge Lawn Care now has their own blog at
For now I am still doing IT and Computer Work under the name.
